newsitem.title: USA: Landmark Bancshares ends stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Landmark Bancshares ends stock buyback.

text.p: Landmark Bancshares Inc said Thursday it discontinued a plan adopted October 16, 1996 to buy back up to 92,649 shares of its common stock by March 27, 1997, the third-year anniversary date of the bank's conversion from mutual to stock form.
President Larry Schugart said the holding company for Landmark Federal Savings Bank repurchased 45,000 shasres at an average cost of about $18.04 per share.
The company completed its offering of 2.3 million shares of common stock at $10 per share on March 28, 1994.
As of March 19, 1997, Landmark, which has implemented four stock repurchase programs, has outstanding 1.8 million shares of common stock.
Schugart said Landmark will consider additional stock repurchases after the expiration of regulatory restrictions applicable until March 27, 1997.
